description:
Grow your career here

Our team is a dedicated, passionate group of people. We’re focused on improving access to government — for everyone. Every employee’s talent and enthusiasm helps us achieve our ambitious mission.

Current Openings
Why we love working at PayIt
Our mission matters

We want to make government interactions simple for residents, and we want to be the best partner our clients have ever worked with. Our work removes barriers and reduces complications, making life easier for residents and government agencies.

We make each other better.

PayIt team members truly stand out — both for their professional talent and for their empathy. Our culture is one of a kind, and each team member helps make our success a little sweeter. We learn together, support each other, and grow together.

We value teamwork, curiosity, and new ideas. We invite every team member to bring their full self to work. Our culture is hands-on so employees gain new skills and get broad exposure across the business. Working at PayIt is an opportunity for real professional growth and career-defining work.

You belong here.

DEI isn’t just an acronym to us. PayIt acknowledges, embraces, and supports folks of all sexual, gender, (dis)ability, religious, racial, and socioeconomic backgrounds. It makes our company culture, our products, and our world better.

Flexibility. Because life happens.

Need to pick up your child from school, take your pup to the vet, or go to the doctor? PayIt hours are flexible so you can take care of whatever life throws at you. We care about the quality of your work, not micromanaging the exact times you’re working.

Whether you want to take a vacation, need a mental health day, or are out sick, it all falls under our flexible PTO policy. We work hard and play hard at PayIt, and we encourage all of our employees to take time to recharge as they see fit.

Challenging work, fantastic culture, and cool benefits
Health, dental, and vision

We’ve got you covered. From 100% employer-paid medical insurance to paid plans, you can select what’s best for your situation. We also pay 100% of dental, vision, and short- and long-term disability insurance for yourself and your family.

Competitive salary

We hire the best and we compensate accordingly. And we’re transparent about the salary range during the hiring process, so you’re never left wondering.

401(k) with company match

Your future is important to us. Our employees can join our 401(k) program — with a company match.

Office space in Kansas City

If you enjoy working in-office, you’ll love our space in the heart of downtown KC. We’ve got comfy common areas, stocked fridges, and private meeting rooms. Being at the office isn’t required, but we love seeing our team members in person.

Current Openings

From client success to engineering to finance, the PayIt team is transforming GovTech and making the lives of everyday people easier.
